Event definition: As the main unit of General Doyen's Alpine army detachment under the 6th Army Group, the division opens the French offensive toward the Little St Bernard Pass on 23 March; its 7th Chasseurs Alpins battalion takes height 2655 but the advance stops at the Roc Noir.
